defs.def: an area of Britain, Ireland or the US that has its own government （英国、爱尔兰的）郡；（美国的）县adjective

ex.s: The house where Reisley has lived for 73 years is located in the woods of Westchester County, New York, just 30 miles north of Manhattan.
ex.t: Reisley住了73年的房子位于纽约州韦斯特切斯特县的树林里，距曼哈顿以北仅30英里。

ex.s: He works for one of Wisconsin’s county highway commissions and came up with the idea of using cheese brine.
ex.t: 他为威斯康星州的一个县公路委员会工作，并想到了用奶酪卤水铺路的主意。

ex.s: That’s exactly what is happening in small neighborhoods around the country from Orange County, California, where 22 measles cases were reported this month, to Brooklyn, N.Y., where a 17-year-old caused an outbreak last year.
ex.t: 这正是全国各个小社区正在发生的情况，从本月报告了22例麻疹的加州奥兰治县，到去年一名17岁少年引发疫情的纽约布鲁克林。

ex.s: We were taken to another town in a faraway county.
ex.t: 我们被带到远方县城里的另一个镇上。

ex.s: John Boynton Priestley (1894 –1984) was born in the English county of Yorkshire, and knew early on that he wanted to become a writer.
ex.t: 约翰·博因顿·普里斯特利（1894-1984）出生在英格兰约克郡，很早就知道自己想成为一名作家。

ex.s: The people live in Wenchuan county will never forget the day 12 May 2008.
ex.t: 住在汶川县的人们永远不会忘记2008年5月12日这一天。

ex.s: The 8.0-magnitude earthquake killed over 80,000 people and left many more injured turned many towns and counties into ruins.
ex.t: 8.0级地震造成八万多人死亡，更多人受伤，许多城镇和县变成了废墟。

ex.s: Wenchuan, the county was completely destroyed and then completely rebuilt, has become a symbol of the Chinese spirit of never giving up.
ex.t: 汶川，这个被彻底摧毁又被彻底重建的县，已经成为永不放弃的中国精神的象征。
